grammar.title: 逃避酒店的原因
lines: That the equipment of modern camping becomes yearly more sophisticated is an entertaining paradox for the cynic, a brighter promise for the hopeful traveler who has sworn to get away from it all . That 引导主语从句（不可省略） yearly adv.每年地，年度地；一年一次地（等同于 annually）adj.每年的；一年一度的（通常修饰事件、活动或费用） get away 去度假；（从繁忙中）抽身；走开 sophisticated 精密的，复杂的，先进的 It also provides — and some student sociologist might care to base his thesis upon the phenomenon — an escape of another kind. student n.实习的；见习的 care for sth. / to do sth. (fml.) = want sth. / to do sth. 愿意(想要)做某事 base … on / upon … 基于...，以...为基础 phenomen on 现象 The modern traveller is often a man who dislikes the Splendide and the Bellavista, not because he cannot afford , or shuns their material comforts, but because he is afraid of them . not … but … 不是...而是... It is not that the scales in the one case, and the balance in the other, differ in the principles of their construction or manner of working; but that the latter is a much finer apparatus and of course much more accurate in its measurement than the former. 考研[英译汉] shun v. to deliberately avoid sb. or sth. 避免，避开，回避 comforts n. [pl.] the things that make your life nicer and more comfortable, esp. things that are not necessary 使人感觉舒适享受的事物 Affluent he may be , but he is by no means sure what to tip the doorman or the chambermaid . Affluent he may be 他可能很富裕（主题性前置）= He may be affluent. What 问费用(How much问价格) by no means 绝不，一点也不 Master in his own house, he has little idea of when to say boo to a Maître d'hôtel . Master in his own house 在他自己的家里是主人（独立主格结构或无动词分钟） have little idea of 对...知之甚少，几乎不知道 boo n. sound made to show disapproval or contempt 呸（表示不赞成或唾弃） maître d’hôtel n. the person in charge of a restaurant or of the people who bring food to your table in a restaurant 饭店经理或服务生领班；餐厅领班（法语）
That all great art has this power of suggesting a world beyond is undeniable.
The company publishes its financial results yearly. 该公司每年公布其财务业绩。
Our membership fees are paid yearly. 我们的会员费是每年支付的。
The technology improves yearly, offering new features. 技术每年都在进步，提供新的功能。
The company publishes its yearly report every January. 公司每年一月发布年度报告。adj.
This festival is held yearly in the heart of the city. 这个节日每年都在市中心举行。adv.
annually adv. 每年；年度地（比 yearly 略显正式，常用于商务或官方语境） The budget is reviewed annually by the board of directors. 预算每年由董事会审查一次。
per annum 每年（常用于利息、薪水等金融或法律合同中） The loan carries an interest rate of 5% per annum. 该贷款的年利率为 5%。
I’ve been working so hard lately that I really need to get away for a few days. 我最近工作太努力了，真的需要抽身去度假几天。
You need to get away from it all for a couple of months.
We decided to go to a remote island to get away from it all. 我们决定去一个偏远的岛屿远离一切烦恼。
get away from it all 远离尘嚣；彻底放松 (have a thoroughly relaxing holiday) We decided to go to a remote island to get away from it all. 我们决定去一个偏远的小岛，彻底远离世俗喧嚣。
getaway n. （适合度假的）地方；短假；逃跑 The mountains are a perfect weekend getaway for city dwellers. 对于城市居民来说，山里是完美的周末度假去处。
get away with (sth.) 侥幸逃脱；（做了坏事）未受惩罚 Don't think you can get away with cheating on the exam. 别以为你考试作弊能瞒天过海。
Modern communication systems are incredibly sophisticated. 现代通信系统非常精密。
The security system is too sophisticated for a casual hacker to breach. 这个安全系统太复杂了，一般的黑客无法攻破。
She has a very sophisticated taste in music and art. 她对音乐和艺术有着非常成熟的品味。
paradox 悖论，矛盾 It is a curious paradox that the less you worry, the better you perform. 这是一个奇怪的悖论，你越不担心，表现得越好。
cynic 愤世嫉俗者 The cynic doubted that the politician's promises were sincere. 愤世嫉俗者怀疑这位政治家的承诺是否真诚。
As a student teacher, she spent the semester observing experienced educators and leading her own classes. 作为一名实习教师，她整个学期都在观察经验丰富的教育工作者，并亲自带领班级。
The student nurse carefully monitored the patient’s vital signs under the supervision of a senior sister. 在资深护士长的监督下，这名实习护士仔细监测病人的生命体征。
trainee (n.) 实习生；受训人员 （更通用的职业称呼） The law firm is looking for a new trainee to join their corporate department. 这家律师事务所正在招募一名新的实习生加入其企业部门。
intern (n.) 实习生 （常指大学生在暑期或毕业前的实习） He worked as an intern at a tech company before landing a full-time job. 在获得全职工作之前，他在一家科技公司担任实习生。
Would you care for a drink?
Would you care to go to a walk?
I don't think he would care to join us for dinner. 我不认为他会愿意和我们一起吃晚餐。
If you care to inspect the damage, you'll see how serious it is. 如果你愿意检查损坏情况，你会发现它有多严重。
Would you care to elaborate on your previous point? 你愿意详细说明你刚才的观点吗？
The entire theory is based upon a flawed premise. 整个理论是基于一个有缺陷的前提。
The book is based upon real events that happened during the war. 这本书是基于战争期间发生的真实事件。
They decided to base their new marketing strategy upon customer feedback. 他们决定将他们的新营销策略基于客户反馈。
Global warming is a serious environmental phenomenon. 全球变暖是一个严重的环境现象。
The aurora borealis is a natural phenomenon that occurs in high-latitude regions. 北极光是一种发生在高纬度地区的自然现象。
phenomen a n. (复数) 现象 Scientists are studying various phenomena related to global warming. 科学家们正在研究与全球变暖相关的各种现象。
criteri on n. (单数) （判断的）标准；准则 Academic ability is not the sole criterion for admission to this college. 学术能力并不是这所大学录取的唯一标准。
criteri a n. (复数) 标准；准则 The committee has established strict criteria for selecting the winner. 委员会为挑选获胜者制定了严格的标准。
What is called 'modern civilization' is not the result of a balanced development of all man's nature, but of accumulated knowledge applied to practical life.
Success is not a matter of luck but a result of hard work. 成功不是靠运气，而是努力的结果。

not that … but that … 不是因为…而是因为… 并不是说…而是说…（用于连接两个从句，解释原因或意图） Not that I love Caesar less, but that I love Rome more. — Shakespeare ‘Julius Caesar’ Not that I don't want to go, but that I am too busy this weekend. 不是我不想去，而是这周末我太忙了。

It is / was not that … but (that) … 不是因为…, 而是因为… It was not that I actually remembered anything at all. But my father had described over and over again what we should see at every milestone after leaving the nearest town.
not because … but because … 不是因为…而是因为… （意义与 not that... but that... 相似，但因果关系更直接） I help him not because he is my relative, but because he is in great need. 我帮他不是因为他是我的亲戚，而是因为他确实需要帮助。
not only … but also … 不仅…而且… （相关联词辨析，强调递进关系） The city is not only a political center but also a cultural metropolis. 这座城市不仅是政治中心，还是文化中心。
He shunned the media spotlight after the scandal broke. 丑闻爆发后，他躲避了媒体的聚光灯。
The villagers began to shun anyone who disagreed with the custom. 村民们开始回避任何不同意习俗的人。
She shuns modern technology, preferring old-fashioned methods. 她回避现代技术，更喜欢老式的方法。
shun sth. （故意地）避开；躲避；回避 To be successful in his studies, he had to shun many social distractions. 为了学业成功，他不得不避开许多社交方面的干扰。
shun luxury 远离奢侈；摒弃奢华 The monk chose to shun luxury and live a simple, contemplative life in the mountains. 这位僧侣选择远离奢侈，在山中过着简朴、沉思的生活。
shun temptation 抵制诱惑；躲避诱惑 It is easier to shun temptation if you stay away from environments that trigger it. 如果你远离那些会引发诱惑的环境，抵制诱惑会更容易。
shun publicity 躲避公众关注；避开名声 Despite her immense wealth, she is a very private person who shuns publicity. 尽管她拥有巨额财富，但她是一个非常低调的人，刻意避开公众关注。
synonyms: avoid / evade / eschew 近义词辨析 （eschew 更为正式，常指因道德或智慧原因避开某事） He eschewed political office to focus on his scientific research. 他避开了官场，以便专注于科学研究。
hotels with all the modern comforts
After the trip, it was nice getting back to a few home comforts.
By comparison, ferry trips or cruises offer a great variety of civilized comforts.
Despite their wealth, they did not care much for material comforts. 尽管他们很富有，但他们不太在乎物质享受。
He gave up a life of material comforts to pursue a spiritual path. 他放弃了物质享受的生活，转而追求精神道路。
Modern society places a high value on material comforts. 现代社会高度重视物质享受。
Rich he may be, but money doesn't buy happiness. 他可能很富有，但金钱买不到幸福。
Tired she may be, but she continues to work hard. 她可能很累，但她继续努力工作。
Skilled they may be, but they still need practice. 他们可能很熟练，但他们仍然需要练习。
宾语前置 Smoking he absolutely loathes. The President praised the loyalists, but the rebels he declared traitors.
宾语补足语前置 A scandal I call it. I knew you were careless, but dishonest I never thought you.
主语补足语前置 (1主语较短时，常不用倒装语序) Very strange it was. Not dogs, but half-tamed wolves they seemed. Affluent he may be, but he is ...
2主语较复杂时，常用倒装语序 （系动词提至主语之前） Gone are the days when China had to depend on foreign oil.
What’s the interest rate?
What’s the balance in my account?
What’s today’s exchange rate for U.S. dollars?
The report is by no means finished; there is still a lot to do. 这份报告绝没有完成；还有很多事情要做。
Winning the game was by no means an easy task. 赢得比赛绝不是一件容易的事。
The small setback is by no means a reason to give up. 这个小小的挫折绝不是放弃的理由。
to tip 给小费 It is customary to tip the waiter 15% in this restaurant. 在这家餐馆给服务员15%的小费是惯例。
A man of few words, David declined to express his opinion.
Writer and music lover, Anne was chosen as a co-author of the book. Who is (the) captain of the team?
President of the company, he made the final decision. 作为公司的总裁，他做了最后的决定。
A veteran of many wars, he knew how to remain calm under fire. 作为经历过许多战争的老兵，他知道如何在炮火下保持冷静。
A genius in mathematics, she found the complex equation simple. 作为数学天才，她觉得这个复杂的方程式很简单。
I have little idea of how to fix a car engine. 我几乎不知道如何修理汽车引擎。
They have little idea of the challenges ahead. 他们对未来的挑战知之甚少。
She has little idea of the impact her words had. 她几乎不知道她的言语产生了什么影响。
He is so timid he wouldn't even say boo to a maitre d'hotel. 他太胆小了，甚至不敢对餐厅领班表示不满。
He sneaked up on his sister and shouted 'Boo!'. 他偷偷溜到妹妹身边，然后大喊一声“嘿！”
Can Israel now say boo to America? 以色列在向美国喝倒彩？
The maitre d'hotel escorted us to our table. 餐厅领班护送我们到我们的桌子旁。
know little about 对...知之甚少 We know little about their personal lives. 我们对他们的私人生活知之甚少。

sentences.title: 变味的露营
lines: From all such fears camping releases him. 为承上启下导致语序改变 Camping releases him from all such fears. 正常语序 release ... from ... 从...中释放，解脱 Granted, a snobbery of camping itself, based upon equipment and techniques, already exists ; but it is of a kind that, if he meets it, he can readily understand and deal with . granted , …, but … 的确, …, 但是 …（让步转折；并列句） 写作高频并列转折 Admittedly, tradition shapes our behavior, but that is not to say that individuals are completely powerless to change it. (诚然，传统塑造了我们的行为，但这并不意味着个人在改变传统面前完全无能为力。) readily adv. 1. willingly 愿意地 readily adv. 2. without difficulty; easily snobbery of 对...的势利态度 There is no superior 'they' in the shape of managements and hotel hierarchies to darken his holiday days. be superior to ... 比...更高级（用原级；不用than）比…更优越；级别更高（反义词为 inferior） 这些以 -ior 结尾的形容词本身含有“比较”含义，因此使用时用原级（不加 more），且后面接 to 而不能用 than。 in the shape / form of 以...形式出现 The majority of the patients attending the medical out-patients departments of our hospitals feel that they have not received adequate treatment unless they are able to carry home with them some tangible remedy in the shape of a bottle of medicine, a box of pills, or a small jar of ointment, and the doctor in charge of the department is only too ready to provide them with these requirements. Convinced of the importance of education, modern states 'invest' in institutions of learning to get back 'interest' in the form of a large group of enlightened young men and women who are potential leaders. hierarchies 等级制度，层级结构
The new policy releases employees from the burden of excessive paperwork. 新政策解除了员工过度文书工作的负担。
Exercise can release stress from the mind. 运动可以从头脑中释放压力。
He was finally released from his promise after many years. 多年后，他终于从他的承诺中解除了。
set free from 从...中解脱 The pardon set the prisoner free from jail. 赦免将囚犯从监狱中解脱出来。
exempt from 免除，豁免 Students are generally exempt from paying income tax on scholarships. 学生通常被豁免支付奖学金的所得税。
Granted, China is still a developing country, but she is full of potential.
Granted, the task is difficult, but it's not impossible. 诚然，任务很困难，但并非不可能。
Granted, he has more experience, but she has better qualifications. 的确，他有更多经验，但她有更好的资历。
Granted, the car is old, yet it runs reliably. 诚然，这辆车很旧，但它运行可靠。
granted (that) …, … 引导让步状语从句 Granted that China is still a developing country, but she is full of potential.

It is / was true that …, but …确实如此，即…，但… It was true that he had just bought a lamb, he explained, but his lamb was black. It is true that during their explorations they often faced difficulties and dangers of the most perilous nature, equipped in a manner with would make a modern climber shudder at the thought, but they did not go out of their way to court such excitement. It is true that China is still a developing country, but she is full of potential.
让步 (Concession) 转折 (Hinge) 反驳/限定 (Qualification)
It is true that ... , but / yet / however that is not to say that ...
Admittedly, ... , it does not necessarily mean that...
Granted, ..., it does not follow that ...
Undoubtedly, ..., there is no guarantee that …
He readily accepted the offer without hesitation. 他毫不犹豫地容易地接受了提议。
As a guest, you should accept their goodwill readily. 作为客人，你应该欣然接受他们的好意。
"Certainly," the young girls readily agreed. “当然。”年轻姑娘们欣然同意。
The equipment was cheap and readily available.
The information is readily accessible on the Internet.
Greater too than we can describe; for language, which was invented to convey the meanings of this world, cannot readily be fitted to the uses of another.
The academic snobbery of the old university was hard to endure. 这所古老大学的学术势利态度令人难以忍受。
There is a subtle snobbery of food choices among the critics. 评论家们之间对食物选择存在一种微妙的势利态度。
She faced a certain snobbery of wealth when she first moved to the neighborhood. 她初搬到这个社区时，面临着一种对财富的势利态度。
based upon 基于 The story is based upon a true historical event. 这个故事是基于一个真实的历史事件。
deal with 处理，应对 She is skilled at dealing with difficult customers. 她擅长处理难缠的顾客。
This new engine is superior to the previous model in terms of fuel efficiency. 这款新引擎在燃油效率方面优于之前的型号。
Human numerical instincts are not so superior to those of other mammals as is generally believed. 人类对于数字的天赋并不像人们普遍认为的那样优于其他哺乳动物。
be inferior to sb./sth. 不如…；级别较低；次于 The copy is inferior to the original painting in both detail and color. 这件复制品在细节和色彩上都不如原画。
be senior to sb. 地位/职位比某人高；年长于某人 She is senior to me in the department, so I report directly to her. 她在部门里的职位比我高，所以我直接向她汇报。
be junior to sb. 地位/职位比某人低；资历较浅 He was junior to most of the other lawyers in the firm. 他的资历比公司里大多数其他律师都要浅。
be prior to sth. 在…之前（常指时间或顺序上的先后） The arrangements were made prior to the meeting. 这些安排是在会议之前做好的。
be posterior to sth. 在…之后（较正式，常用于学术或解剖学语境） The discovery of the manuscript was posterior to the publication of the biography. 手稿的发现晚于传记的出版。
Help arrived in the shape of a large grant from the government. 帮助以政府一大笔拨款的形式出现了。
The biggest challenge came in the shape of a sudden market crash. 最大的挑战以市场突然崩溃的形式出现。
He received criticism in the shape of an anonymous letter. 他收到了以匿名信形式出现的批评。
The company is moving away from strict corporate hierarchies. 该公司正在摆脱严格的公司等级制度。
Social hierarchies are less rigid in modern society. 现代社会中的社会等级制度不那么僵化。
A clear chain of command is essential in military hierarchies. 明确的指挥链在军事层级结构中至关重要。

expand.title: 露营高雅的改良
lines: To such motives, yet another must be added . yet / still another / one more… 又一个；再一个（强调“已经很多了，居然又来一个”，常带有一丝惊讶、无奈或强调数量之多） Another 常接单数名词；Yet another 则强烈暗示这只是漫长序列中的最新一个（"one more in a long series"）。 The contemporary phenomenon of car worship is to be explained not least by the sense of independence and freedom that ownership entails . be to do (fml.) 的四种用法 Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be chewed and digested. — Francis Bacon not least (fml.) especially, in particular 尤其是，特别是 a sense of + n. ...感 To this pleasure camping gives an exquisite refinement. Camping gives an exquisite refinement to this pleasure. 正常顺序 exquisite adj. very sensitive and delicate in the way you behave or do things 高雅的 refinement n. [U & C] a small change that is made to something in order to improve it 改进，改良 gives a refinement 给予/带来提升
yet one more question
still another example
This led to yet another angry argument.
She was yet another victim, reduced to a screaming wreck.
Just as I thought I had finished the report, the boss gave me yet another task to complete. 正当我以为已经写完报告时，老板又给了我一个任务。
The company launched a successful product, and now they are preparing yet another one. 该公司推出了一款成功的产品，现在他们又在准备另一个。
After solving one problem, they were immediately faced with yet another challenge. 解决了一个问题之后，他们立即又面临了另一个挑战。
We had finished all the tasks, but the manager assigned us yet another urgent report. 我们完成了所有的任务，但经理又给我们分配了另一份紧急报告。
yet / still more 更多的 （用于不可数名词或强调程度的增加） The project will require still more time and money than we originally estimated. 该项目所需的时间和金钱将比我们最初估计的还要多。
one more 再多一个 （中性表达，指在现有基础上增加一个） Could I have one more cup of coffee, please? 请问能再给我来一杯咖啡吗？
another / one more … and … 再…就… （常用于假设或警告） One more mistake and you’ll be fired. 再犯一次错，你就会被解雇。
The strange noise is to be explained before anyone can rest easy. 在任何人能安心之前，这个奇怪的噪音有待解释。
打算，想要 I am to see her tomorrow. But instruments far more delicate than that were needed if any really serious advance was to be made.
命令 You’re to be back by 10 o’clock. No one is to leave the building.
能够 How am I to pay such a debt? We Chinese people are not to be bullied.

应该 Such men are to be pitied rather than despised. As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away, they were not to take him seriously.
The film caused a lot of bad feeling, not least among the workers whose lives it described.
My mother was upset about his appearance here, not least because she felt it was invading her privacy.
The success of the project was achieved not least by the dedication of the team. 这个项目的成功尤其归功于团队的奉献。
His reputation grew, not least by his groundbreaking research. 他的声誉有所增长，特别是由于他的开创性研究。
The event was memorable, not least by the presence of the celebrity guest. 这个活动令人难忘，特别是由于名人的出席。
The sense of humor is mysteriously bound up with national characteristics.
No matter how much we like honey, or how much we have read about the uncanny sense of direction which bees possess, we have a horror of being stung.
Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour -- everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
He simply had no sense of danger at all.
a sense of independence 独立感 Studying abroad helped her develop a strong sense of independence. 留学帮助她培养了强烈的独立感。
a sense of freedom 自由感 Cycling through the countryside gives me a wonderful sense of freedom. 在乡间骑行给我一种美妙的自由感。
a sense of direction 方向感；目标感 Without a clear sense of direction, it's easy to feel lost in your career. 如果没有明确的目标感，很容易在职业生涯中感到迷茫。
a sense of humor 幽默感 He has a great sense of humor and always makes everyone laugh. 他非常有幽默感，总能逗大家笑。
a sense of justice 正义感 Her deep sense of justice led her to become a human rights lawyer. 深藏内心的正义感促使她成为了一名人权律师。
a sense of pride 自豪感 The team felt a deep sense of pride after winning the championship. 夺冠后，全队感到深深的自豪。
a sense of honor 荣誉感 Serving one's country is often seen as a sense of honor and duty. 为国效力通常被视为一种荣誉感和责任。
a sense of accomplishment 成就感 Finishing a marathon gives you an incredible sense of accomplishment. 跑完马拉松会给你带来巨大的成就感。
a sense of responsibility 责任感 Parenthood brings with it a tremendous sense of responsibility. 为人父母随之而来的是巨大的责任感。
a sense of superiority 优越感 He looked down on his colleagues with a smug sense of superiority. 他带着一种自鸣得意的优越感轻视他的同事。
a sense of inferiority 自卑感 Constant criticism can leave a child with a lasting sense of inferiority. 不断的批评会给孩子留下持久的自卑感。
She has exquisite taste in art.
The wind then speaks the message of the sun to the sea and the sea transmits it on through waves—an ancient, exquisite, powerful message.
These refinements have increased the machine's accuracy by 25%. 可数
Clearly, the hypothesis does need some refinement, in the light of these surprising results. 不可数
The chef added an exquisite refinement to the classic dish. 这位厨师为这道经典菜肴增添了精美的改进。
Her piano playing showed an exquisite refinement of technique. 她的钢琴演奏展示了精致的技术提升。
The latest model features an exquisite refinement in design and functionality. 最新型号在设计和功能上都具有精美的改进。
a person of great refinement 举止优雅的人；极有教养的人 （指在举止、言语或品味上非常高雅） As a person of great refinement, he was naturally chosen to host the international gala. 作为一个举止极其优雅的人，他自然而然地被选为国际盛会的司仪。
an atmosphere of refinement 高雅的氛围；考究的气氛 The restaurant was decorated with antique furniture to create an atmosphere of refinement. 这家餐厅用古董家具装饰，以营造一种高雅的氛围。
refinement of sth. （技术、计划等的）改进；完善 The refinement of the manufacturing process led to much higher product quality. 制造工艺的改进使产品质量得到了大幅提升。
polished (adj.) 文雅的；有教养的（常用来修饰人的举止或表现） She gave a polished performance that impressed all the judges. 她表现得大方得体，给所有评委都留下了深刻印象。
The use of high-quality materials gives the product a noticeable refinement. 使用高质量的材料为产品带来了明显的提升。
Reading classical literature gives your vocabulary a refinement. 阅读古典文学为你的词汇带来了提升。
A good education gives a refinement to one's manners and speech. 良好的教育为人的举止和言语带来了提升。
